scripts.dev: concurrently -n "api,web" -c "cyan,green" "cd server && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../server && npm run lint
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.clean: cd frontend && rm -rf dist && cd ../server && npm run clean
